notes:
Summary: mid-market e‑commerce platform exploring model-backed recommendations + reranking to improve CVR. Primary metric: lift in add-to-cart / checkout conv. Big ask: move off current batch heuristic to low-latency LLM reranker.

Key pain: token & GPU unit economics. They run heavy long-context reranks (~1.5k tokens avg per request) which pushes token cost and GPU utilization. Client repeatedly: "we like the latency and control but numbers don't add up".

Price discussion:
- Proposal v1 = $120k/yr (dedicated, small fleet, burst capacity). Client says commit too large vs forecasted uplift.
- Procurement asked for month-to-month pilot or 3-mo micro-commit (<= $25k) to validate ROI. Our minimum commit + set-up SLA is a blocker.

Security/compliance:
- They require SSO (SAML), audit logs, and KMS integration. Confirmed Redwood Private meets requirements but cost delta is large.
- Security team still has open Qs on data residency and retention windows (drive doc link).

Competitive pressure:
- Client received a lower-commit offer from CloudGenAI (fixed monthly token bucket + cheaper GPU-backed inference). Sales said CloudGenAI willing to undercut on first-year price to win pilot.

Internal champion:
- Product lead (Maya Chen) enthusiastic; procurement not convinced. No exec sponsor yet.

Quote from product lead: "Architecture looks great — worried we'll blow the budget if we scale reranks across categories. Need a smaller proof point."
